text:
Lee Jin-woo, a person facing allegations of AI cheating on Korea’s law school and college entrance exams, disappeared Thursday morning after failing to show up for a scheduled live "verification test." He had promised to prove his innocence and capability by solving the Korean section of this year's College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) in real time.
Admissions officials said Lee was scheduled to arrive at a testing center in southern Seoul by 8 a.m. But he did not show up.
Lee drew scrutiny after surging from low past scores to missing just one question on the last year's CSAT — earning admission to the prestigious Seoul National University’s dental school — and later scoring a perfect mark on the 2027 Legal Education Eligibility Test (LEET). He is the first person to achieve that since the exam was introduced in 2008.
Doubts over his sudden academic rise intensified after the top scorer on the national tax accountant exam recently confessed to AI-aided cheating.
